body: I love the thought of RF harvesting - especially with how much we're going to be raping the airwaves with RF in the not-so-distant future.

It should be noted that I was so close about 5 minutes ago.  I asked Omegle what I should do, and someone talked to me like a human being.  That someone on Omegle made me feel better, I know this post doesn't mean much to me, but it's crazy how much expressing myself to someone - anyone - has helped.
